7.name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
desc: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
objectives: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
details: Your first task is one of cleansing, $N. A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north. Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find. Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
completion: Well done, citizen. Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us. And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.
BFor defeating them, you have my gratitude.

31.name: Aquatic Form
desc: Return to Thunder Bluff and show Turak Runetotem the Pendant of the Sea Lion.
objectives: Return to Thunder Bluff and show Turak Runetotem the Pendant of the Sea Lion.
details: You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect. Go now back to your trainer, Turak Runetotem, in Thunder Bluff. Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you. He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.
BGoodbye, young druid. We shall speak again.
completion: Very impressive, $N. Your ancestors would be pleased with your progress! You're ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.

BAlso, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item. I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.

55.name: Morbent Fel
desc: Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
objectives: Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
details: Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery. His time in this land is drawing to an end...
BUse Morbent's Bane against him. It will render his protective magics powerless.
BSlay him. Slay him, and save us from his wickedness. Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of Duskwood!
completion: Morbent Fel has been defeated. The dark riders are still at large, but a small piece of that which I had hoped beyond hope has come to pass.
BYou have done the impossible, and your deeds will forever live in the legends of Duskwood.
BGo, $N. And perhaps, one day, fate may bring you back to me...

79.name: The Legend of Stalvan
desc: Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.
objectives: Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.
details: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years. When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate. I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods. Your trail of evidence proves his guilt. Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
completion: My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, $C.

103.name: Keeper of the Flame
desc: Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
objectives: Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
details: The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible. I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack. But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline. With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.
BHelp me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
completion: Praise you, brave $C. The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work. Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.
BI died needlessly on this very shore. My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.

127.name: Selling Fish
desc: Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
objectives: Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
details: Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish. There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!
BBring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them. If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
completion: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!

151.name: Poor Old Blanchy
desc: Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.
objectives: Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.
details: Poor Old Blanchy! Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.
BI bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
completion: Thank you so much, $N! Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!

175.name: Look To The Stars
desc: Locate Mary and persuade her to give up a reflective surface for Viktori's project.
objectives: Locate Mary and persuade her to give up a reflective surface for Viktori's project.
details: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light. I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass. Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project? I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
completion: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.

199.name: A Dark Threat Looms
desc: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.
objectives: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.
details: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.
completion: This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!

223.name: Worgen in the Woods
desc: Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.
objectives: Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.
details: Here you go, $n. Bring this message to Master Carevin.
B<He quickly removes a piece of faded parchment and offers it to you.>
BA few more like you, and we will outnumber the Night Watch! Perhaps then we could complete the work that we few carry on today.
completion: Excuse me for my cold reception, $N, but as I'm sure you can tell, I am an extremely busy man. I see that you have impressed Calor--and I assure you, that is no small feat--and that he has given his recommendation.

BThere are unsavory types afoot, $N, and we can use the help of all who have proven themselves. We battle against demons, the undead, and those who would provide them aid. Be vigilant, be wary, and trust none who would not give aid to our cause.
BGlory under the Light.

247.name: The Hunt Completed
completion: $N, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt. You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity. The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!
BPlease, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today. May your ancestors watch over you!

271.name: Vyrin's Revenge
desc: Kill Ol' Sooty then show your handiwork to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge.
objectives: Kill Ol' Sooty then show your handiwork to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge.
details: I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.

BA year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.
BKill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.
BThe bear, Ol' Sooty, can be found around his lair in the hills over Thelsamar.
completion: Er... what's this? A bear's head, by the looks at it.
B<He runs a finger along his scar unconsciously.>
BWell, that's quite an interesting kill you have yourself there. Couldn't be that bear from back then...
B<He trails off then starts to visibly shake.>
BOh, take that away take it away! Get that grisly thing out of here!

295.name: Ormer's Revenge
desc: Ormer Ironbraid wants you to kill 10 Mottled Scytheclaw raptors and 10 Mottled Razormaw raptors then return to him at the Whelgar Excavation Site.
objectives: Ormer Ironbraid wants you to kill 10 Mottled Scytheclaw raptors and 10 Mottled Razormaw raptors then return to him at the Whelgar Excavation Site.
details: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!
completion: You did a bang-up job of clearing out those Raptors, $N!

319.name: A Favor for Evershine
desc: Kill 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars, and 8 Snow Leopards, and then return to Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.
objectives: Kill 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars, and 8 Snow Leopards, and then return to Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.
details: I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor? Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows. Sometimes they wander close.
BWe're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting dwarf would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.
completion: Thank you, $N. It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.

343.name: Speaking of Fortitude
desc: Go to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep and speak with Milton Sheaf. He can find for you the book on metallurgy that Brother Kristoff needs for his speech.
objectives: Go to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep and speak with Milton Sheaf. He can find for you the book on metallurgy that Brother Kristoff needs for his speech.
details: I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron." A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep. Can you retrieve it for me? If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!
BThe Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son. Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
completion: Metallurgy? Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech! Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?

367.name: A New Plague
desc: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.
objectives: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.
details: Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise. She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.
BMy studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
completion: You have done well, $N and I thank you for your efforts.

391.name: The Stockade Riots
desc: Kill Bazil Thredd and bring his head back to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade.
objectives: Kill Bazil Thredd and bring his head back to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade.
details: Let's get one thing straight, $N: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

BSo here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
completion: Without Thredd to lead them, hopefully the riots will be more controllable. We shall see.
BI must say, after a half hour, I hardly expected you to come out, but it seems I misjudged you.
BI'd guess, then, that you didn't get much useful information out of him? But I know a thing or two that might be of interest to you about Thredd's activities.

415.name: Rejold's New Brew
desc: Speak with Rejold Barleybrew.
objectives: Speak with Rejold Barleybrew.
details: Rejold Barleybrew at Brewnall Village has been asking for you.
BHe wants to talk to you about a new drink he's been brewing...said something about you helping him with it. You might want to head back to Brewnall Village and see what he has to say.
BThere could be some free booze in it for you...
completion: $N! You know that Shimmerweed you brought me? Well I used it in a few recipes I've been working on, and one of them turned out great!
BHere, try it out and tell me what you think...

439.name: Rot Hide Clues
desc: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
details: Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped. It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.
BOn the hand is a ring. Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:
B"For Deliah"
completion: You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?
BThe only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal. The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!

463.name: The Greenwarden
desc: Find the Greenwarden.
objectives: Find the Greenwarden.
details: You've heard of the Greenwarden? You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from $ghis:her; death?
BIf you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!
BAnd leave your money here. You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
completion: The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to only a few. But you may call me Rethiel.
BAnd you must harken...for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

487.name: The Road to Darnassus
desc: Slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to Sentinel Amara Nightwalker outside of Dolanaar.
objectives: Slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to Sentinel Amara Nightwalker outside of Dolanaar.
details: The road to Darnassus must be kept safe. Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.
BImportant news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily. We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.
BTake up arms in the name of the sacred forest, $c. Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point. Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
completion: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave $C. As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.

511.name: Encrypted Letter
desc: Bring the Encrypted Letter to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.
objectives: Bring the Encrypted Letter to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.
details: One of the letters on this table is encrypted and inscrutable.
completion: What is this? Hold a moment... let me take a closer look.
BHm, I have never before seen this form of encryption, but I must admit that my knowledge in that area is by no means complete.

535.name: Valik
desc: Bring a mug of Southshore Stout to Valik in the Syndicate camp.
objectives: Bring a mug of Southshore Stout to Valik in the Syndicate camp.
details: Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the enemy.
BNo doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some Southshore stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.
completion: Given my impending death, I think I can safely say that this is the sweetest tasting thing ever... Here, take this, won't do me any good when I'm dead.
BWell, get on with it!

559.name: Farren's Proof
desc: Collect 10 Murloc Heads from the murlocs on the Western Strand for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.
objectives: Collect 10 Murloc Heads from the murlocs on the Western Strand for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.
details: Would you believe it, $n? Redpath wasn't satisfied with all the murlocs we killed--oh now, don't be modest, you had some hand in it. Now he wants me to bring proof of the dead, hacking off cold, slimy murloc heads to submit for his approval.
completion: Oh for the Love of the Light... they're dripping on the ground.

BCan't stand touching those things, myself. Fish are all well and good, but when they grow legs and start walking around... Haven't eaten a fish in weeks, let me tell you, and in Southshore, that means you aren't eating much.

583.name: Welcome to the Jungle
desc: Speak with Hemet Nesingwary
objectives: Speak with Hemet Nesingwary
details: Welcome to Stranglethorn!

BPerhaps you're not aware of this, but that dwarf over there is the one and only Hemet Nesingwary, renowned war hero of the Alliance and master big game hunter. He's not one for welcoming strangers into his camp, but you look like you've seen quite a bit of action in your day, $c.
BBeing a veteran of many battles himself, Master Nesingwary has a soft spot for fellow heroes.
BGo and speak with him. Perhaps he can give you some hunting pointers.
completion: Jolly nice to make your acquaintance, $N. Haven't seen a $C around these parts for some time.

BI situated myself with this expedition for one purpose: to hunt a great and elusive beast. Seeing that you're a hero of sorts I am willing to let you take part in the hunt, but you must first prove yourself.
BI shall teach the ways of raptor killing to you. Ajeck will train you with tiger hunting. And Sir Erlgadin is a master of panther tracking.
BProve your skill and I'll let you in on the big hunt.

607.name: Return to MacKinley
desc: Bring Shaky's Payment to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley.
objectives: Bring Shaky's Payment to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley.
details: Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf. And tell him I meant to pay him back! I swear!!
BI just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are. He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!
completion: Heh heh, well done! And when you showed Shaky those giblets, how hard did he shake?
BHah! He's so easy to read, when I play cards with him I can't help but win!
BThanks for your help, $N. Now it's your turn to get paid...

631.name: The Thandol Span
desc: Rhag Garmason wants you to locate Ol' Rustlocke.
objectives: Rhag Garmason wants you to locate Ol' Rustlocke.
details: A tremendous explosion roared through the hills. 'Twas horrible, I tell you!
BGood soldiers died defending the Thandol Span. Longbraid says we'll take revenge on the Dark Irons before all is said and done.
BWe're in a world of hurt though and I don't see any reinforcements in sight. Longbraid sent Ol' Rustlocke to scout the eastern bridge to see if we could secure it.
BThat was days ago. We haven't the manpower to search for him with Dun Modr under siege.
BPerhaps you can find him...
completion: You search the tiny, dwarven corpse. Engraved into the helmet you can clearly read: Ebenezer Rustlocke.

655.name: Hammerfall
desc: Speak with Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
objectives: Speak with Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
details: It is still clear to me, like yesterday... So many years without hope, with wood and steel to bind me to this terrible place. Then finally, finally! There was the Warchief. Doomhammer in his midnight plate, his warhammer held high.

BIt was... too terrible... That the blow of a coward would strike down our greatest hero. From behind he charged on his horse, and then his lance ran him through... I fell to my knees. What hope was there? What hope is there...
completion: Ah, Gor'mul you speak of. Yes, from what he says, it seems he has never recovered from the death of Doomhammer.

BGor'mul was a captive here when Thrall and Orgrim fought to free the camp, but as the earth shook and our brethren escaped, he was left behind. He wandered alone and lost for years without direction or hope, until we returned to establish ourselves here in Hammerfall.

679.name: Call to Arms
desc: Kill 7 Boulderfist Shaman and 3 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
objectives: Kill 7 Boulderfist Shaman and 3 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
details: The head of the beast is ready to be taken off... with great force, $N. You have shown every sign that you are able to help us with this final mighty blow. The leaders of these attacks have made their lair within the ruins of Stromgarde, a glaring symbol of human frailty.
BFind and slay those Boulderfist lords and their lackey shaman who would try and drive us from these lands.
completion: You do your people proud, $N. The threat has been greatly lessened, and I am sure we will begin to thrive here in the Highlands.

703.name: Barbecued Buzzard Wings
desc: Bring 4 Buzzard Wings to Rigglefuzz.
objectives: Bring 4 Buzzard Wings to Rigglefuzz.
details: Oh yes, my barbecued buzzard wings are a favorite! The sauce is rich and the meat is tangy. And the smell will bring the hungry running from miles away!
BI have everything I need to cook up a batch. Everything...except the buzzard wings!
BIf you want some then get me the buzzard wings. Bring me enough, and I might even share the recipe with you!
completion: Ah, I'll get started on those wings right away. I can almost taste them already!
BAnd here's the recipe in case you want to make them yourself!

727.name: To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest
desc: Give the Sigil of the Hammer to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.
objectives: Give the Sigil of the Hammer to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.
details: The Tablet tells much. But not enough! Not nearly enough!

BThere is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past. The ... people I fled ... they keep this book in many places. And their most learned study it. It holds vast knowledge. Knowledge to protect us!
BGo to Gerrig Bonegrip. He is in a shop in Ironforge, in the Forlorn Cavern. Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them. Ask him for Yagyin's Digest ... and bring it to me!
completion: Oh. Greetings, brother.
BAnd praise to the dwellers beneath.

751.name: The Ravaged Caravan
desc: Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
details: Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in Mulgore. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.
BUp in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
completion: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.

775.name: Journey into Thunder Bluff
desc: Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
details: You will now be revered within our great city. Any $r worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.
BFor your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.
completion: Hail, young $C. I see you found your way to my doorstep.

823.name: Report to Orgnil
desc: Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
objectives: Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
details: We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid. But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

BThere is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade! Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials. He will want to know these things.
BRazor Hill lies to the north.
completion: Yes? You have something to report? Well then, let's have it!

847.name: Guile of the Raptor
desc: Speak with Tor'gan.
objectives: Speak with Tor'gan.
details: This... this power.... Is this the power of the shamans that Tor'gan tried to show me? I must say, it is interesting. Tell Tor'gan that he has convinced me... for the time being. I will listen to what he has to say.
completion: When the enchantment wears off, I will speak with Gor'mul. My thanks to you for your help in returning Gor'mul to the land of the living. I have no doubt he thanks you greatly as well.

871.name: Disrupt the Attacks
desc: Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.
objectives: Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.
details: All the quilboars are our enemies, $N. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.

BThe Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from Durotar, causing us no end of annoyance. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.
BStart in the northeast towards Durotar. You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. Seek them out, and slay them.
completion: You have done well, $N. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.

895.name: WANTED: Baron Longshore
desc: Bring the head of Baron Longshore to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
objectives: Bring the head of Baron Longshore to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
details: WANTED!
BBaron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless
BCaptain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!
B-- Gazlowe
completion: Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!
BAnyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.

919.name: Timberling Sprouts
desc: Bring 12 Timberling Sprouts to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
objectives: Bring 12 Timberling Sprouts to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
details: Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth. I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.
BWhen you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them. Help keep our land clean!
completion: That's a lot! I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate. I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.
BThank you for your help, $N. The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.

943.name: The Absent Minded Prospector
desc: Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil Harbor wants you to bring him the Stone of Relu and Flagongut's Fossil.
objectives: Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil Harbor wants you to bring him the Stone of Relu and Flagongut's Fossil.
details: Prospector Whelgar now holds the original fossil at his site in the Wetlands. When I discovered the Stone of Relu, I believed it to be the key to unlocking the mystery of the fossil.

BWhile I traveled on the road to meet Whelgar, I was attacked by raptors and the relic was lost. I don't know which one of the mottled beasts swallowed the relic but if you can retrieve it, I can unleash the power of these artifacts.
BBring me both the Stone of Relu, and the original fossil he holds.
completion: Most excellent, $N!
BNow to see if I can use the stone to decipher the powers of the fossils.

967.name: The Tower of Althalaxx
desc: Deliver Balthule's letter to Delgren the Purifier in Ashenvale Forest.
objectives: Deliver Balthule's letter to Delgren the Purifier in Ashenvale Forest.
details: My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and undead. He has taught me much about the Holy Light and the art of battle.
BDelgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.
BYou will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale Forest. Be swift, I fear the Dark Strand's threat grows with each passing hour.
completion: If you don't mind my saying, you seem a bit well-equipped for a messenger, hm? I suppose Balthule wanted to be certain that his letter reached my hands. Let's see what he has to say...
BThis is disturbing news. When undead or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.
BAt first I was unaccustomed to the manners of the night elves, but I have grown to respect them greatly as allies.

991.name: Raene's Cleansing
desc: Find Teronis in Ashenvale.
objectives: Find Teronis in Ashenvale.
details: $N, a longtime friend of mine is also aiding the Sentinels here in Ashenvale, but he has yet to return.
BHe had leads on finding an item that he thought could slow the furbolg attacks on our people--a rod created by a now-dead, evil wizard.
BBefore he left here, he mentioned seeking out a gem for the rod.
BHe mentioned the gem possibly being hidden at the shrine in Lake Falathim at the base of the mountain to the west. The gem was being held there before it was overrun.
BFind my friend, $N, please.
completion: Teronis' body lies broken atop the island. For some unknown reason, the murlocs have left it alone.
BThe deep slashes across his corpse obviously came from the weapons and claws of the murlocs.

1015.name: The New Frontier
desc: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
details: Attention, heroes!

BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
completion: What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, $C? Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. By all means, the welfare of Darnassus - nay, all of Teldrassil - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.
BThe fools in Moonglade waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?

1039.name: The Barrens Port
desc: Speak with Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
objectives: Speak with Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
details: Ratchet is the only port in the Barrens. Most likely Velinde found a trading vessel in Ratchet to take her to Blackwater Cove in Azeroth. We've had limited dealings with the goblins that run the port, but the master of the dock should have information about the comings and goings of ship passengers.
BFollow the road southeast through Ashenvale and you will find yourself in the Barrens. Watch your step, $n, warriors of the Horde patrol the land. You will be safe at the port, though.
completion: $R, eh? Must admit, we don't get much of your type out here. Looking for someone, eh? Just give me a moment, I'm sure I have it written in one of my ledgers.
BLot of people travel through here, though, so just give me a moment.

1063.name: The Elder Crone
desc: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
details: To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the tauren elders.
BI do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha. I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much. If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the tauren, it is she.
BMagatha resides in the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff, on Elder Rise -- the city's northeastern bluff. Speak with Magatha, and tell her of the peril of Stonetalon Mountains.
completion: I bid you greetings. You are here seeking council?

1087.name: Cenarius' Legacy
desc: Kill 4 Sons of Cenarius, 4 Daughters of Cenarius and 4 Cenarion Botanists for Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.
objectives: Kill 4 Sons of Cenarius, 4 Daughters of Cenarius and 4 Cenarion Botanists for Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.
details: You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.
BWould that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.
BI have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
completion: Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.
BWhat a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!

1111.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
desc: Bring Kravel's Parts Order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
objectives: Bring Kravel's Parts Order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
details: I make it my job to get people what they need, and the gnomes over there need a parts order filled. Their parts were shipped to Ratchet a week ago, but I haven't been able to make the trip.
BSo, are you ready for some legwork? Go to Ratchet and give this parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig -- he'll probably be at the docks.
BDo this for me, and I'll have more jobs for you.
BJobs, my friend, with serious profit potential...
completion: Oh yes. Parts for Kravel. I'm glad you're here. These things have been sitting out here for days, and I was afraid they'd rust!

1135.name: Highperch Venom
desc: Bring 10 Highperch Venom Sacs to Fiora Longears in Theramore.
objectives: Bring 10 Highperch Venom Sacs to Fiora Longears in Theramore.
details: As you may know, wyverns are often tamed by orcs for use as mounts. But what is less known is that the venom of a wyvern, in some circles, is more valuable than the beast itself. So if you're not afraid to do a little wyvern hunting, then... I have a job for you.
BThere is a place called Highperch in the land of a Thousand Needles, west of here. The Highperch wyverns have a potent venom. Potent, and valuable.
completion: Ah, most of these are nearly bursting with venom, $N. Such are normally only gathered from young wyverns, or fertile females. It must have been quite a slaughter up there in Highperch!

1159.name: Test of Lore
desc: Find Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.
objectives: Find Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.
details: Well done, $N. You have passed the first portion of the Test of Lore, but there is still another question to be answered. But that question is not mine to ask.
BSeek out Parqual Fintallas in Lordaeron City. He was a great historian for the humans before the Plague overtook him. Now he continues to seek enlightenment, but of a different nature.
BHe will have another requirement of you before he asks you anything, but you have done masterfully thus far--I'm sure you will overcome his obstacle.
completion: Braug sent you? Impossible.
B<Parqual looks you up and down.>

BBraved Dor'Danil, took a leap of faith, fought and overpowered a powerful elemental? Bah! You're probably a farce; some adventurer that overheard talk in a tavern. And now you think you have what it takes to pass my test. So be it... $C.

1183.name: Goblin Sponsorship
desc: Deliver the Fuel Regulator Blueprints to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Deliver the Fuel Regulator Blueprints to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
details: You should be all set to go. Give Pozzik my regards and tell him that if he ever needs anything, not to hesitate to ask. I'll be waiting for the news that he breaks the track record soon!
completion: I was hoping that it would be already assembled, but this does present the unique opportunity to improve on the design from the ground up. Thanks, $N. I'll be able to sketch up some improved schematics, build the thing, and have it installed real soon.

1375.name: Khan Shaka
desc: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring the Head of Khan Shaka to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring the Head of Khan Shaka to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
details: You help the Magram, and I like you. Now, kill the Khan of the Gelkis! He is Khan Shaka, and I want his head! I want to stare at his head and laugh at him!
completion: Khan Shaka is dead! I will place his head on a pike, and keep it with me so Shaka can see the strength of the Magram!

1423.name: The Lost Supplies
desc: Bring the Lost Supplies to Quartermaster Lungertz.

1447.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Defeat Dashel Stonefist in Stormwind.
objectives: Defeat Dashel Stonefist in Stormwind.
details: Yeah, you're obviously not the smartest $c to come into Stormwind, but you're about to be one of the dumbest to never leave.$b$bHave you met me friends?
completion: So, you came to me for a reason. What is it you need?

1471.name: The Binding
desc: Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
objectives: Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
details: Surely you have seen the circle of summoning below us? Only there will you be able to draw forth an unbound voidwalker.
BUsing these runes, you will be able to draw it forth, and then you must dominate it through strength of arms and magic.
BWhen it is subdued, it will be indentured to you. Come to me then, and I will elucidate the spell of summoning, so that it may serve you to whatever end you wish.
completion: You have done well, $N. Now, I will impart to you the spell used for summoning the voidwalker.
BThe power that it unleashed upon you is now yours to command. Use it wisely.

1519.name: Call of Earth
desc: Bring 2 applications of Ritual Salve to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.
objectives: Bring 2 applications of Ritual Salve to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.
details: The time has come, young $c. Your body ages and grows strong, and your spirit endures like the earth. I see it within you-you have wisdom already.
BThe earth guides our people, and it speaks to us, as it will to you in time. But you must be tested. If you are ready, then you shall see things only our kind know of.
BSeek out the Bristleback shamans in their ravine to the east, and take from them a salve they use in their rituals. Return to me only when you have enough for your own potion.
completion: Good, $N. Your return here signifies that you are indeed prepared for the next step.

BOf all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. The Earth Mother will protect you, but only if you show her proper respect. She is the basis for life, and by observing her laws, you will gain a greater wisdom. Never forget the secrets she shares with you.
BI shall make your sapta for you now, and by accepting it, a new path will open before you.

1639.name: Bartleby the Drunk
desc: Speak with Bartleby.
objectives: Speak with Bartleby.
details: Yeah, I can teach you. But first I wanna see what moves you have already.
BSee that drunk over there at the end of the bar? Bartleby? I want you to get his mug.
BHah, and if you know Bartleby then you know he won't just give it to you.
completion: Hello, fancy $gboy:girl;! What's a prissy thing like you doing in the Pig and Whistle? Be careful, or you might break a nail...

1687.name: Spooky Lighthouse
desc: Take the orphan to see the lighthouse off the coast of Westfall.
objectives: Take the orphan to see the lighthouse off the coast of Westfall.$B
details: Sometimes late at night, our matrons at the orphanage will tell us spooky stories. Those RULE! There's one about a ghost that haunts a lighthouse in Westfall. They say he was a pirate captain who had his ship taken from him by other pirates. Wow!
BCould you please take me to the lighthouse in Westfall? I wanna see if the ghost of that captain is there! I promise to stay close to you; I won't run off or anything!
completion: WOW, that was a real life ghost! That was so awesome - I can't wait to tell everyone back at the orphanage. Captain Grayson... he even looked like a pirate! When I grow up I wanna be a ghost pirate too!
BThanks for taking me to Westfall, $N. I know there are scary things out there in the wilds of Westfall, and I hope I wasn't too much of a pain. You're awesome!

1711.name: Mathiel's Armor
completion: I have finished with your piece of armor, and I am quite pleased. Furen's new techniques meshed perfectly with my own and I am sure this armor will prove to be quite resilient.
BThank you, $N. And may this serve you well in future battles.

1783.name: The Tome of Divinity
desc: Take the Symbol of Life and resurrect Narm Faulk in Dun Morogh.
objectives: Take the Symbol of Life and resurrect Narm Faulk in Dun Morogh.
details: We was spyin' on some of the Dark Iron dwarves that've bunkered down south of Helm's Bed Lake. We knew they was up to no good, so Narm an' me thought we'd take a closer look--got ta see their leader given orders to some o' his men.
BNarm an' me took the chance to kill a few of 'em, but they proved tougher than we thought, an' more of 'em got the jump on us. Narm tol' me to run an' get support, so 'ere I am.
BNarm needs help, an' I'll not rest till he gets it.
BC'n ya help, $N?
completion: I can't thank you enough, $gbrother:sister;.
BI can only assume that Tiza and Muiredon sent you here to aid me if you carry the Symbol of Life.

BIt's true, I fell to the Dark Iron while trying to attain one of the scripts: I was able to hold on long enough to allow Muiredon to escape, but the Light had almost embraced me fully when you came along. The fact that you were powerful enough to use the Symbol means great things for you, but there's time to speak of that later.

1879.name: Speak with Bink
desc: Speak with Bink in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak with Bink in Ironforge.
details: $N! Bink, my gnome colleague in Ironforge, sends word. She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a mage to do it! Are you that mage, $N?
BIf so, then speak with Bink. She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.
completion: Oh, I can see you have promise, yes you do! But it takes more than promise to be a good mage. And if you're not a good mage, then you're a bad mage. And bad mages are part of the problem, yes they are!
BOops, I'm getting ahead of things. Let's begin at the start!

1951.name: Rituals of Power
desc: Bring the book Rituals of Power to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
objectives: Bring the book Rituals of Power to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
details: Hm... now that I think about it, I don't have my book! You see, I had some gambling debts and to pay them off I sold the last copy of Rituals of Power to a member of the clergy....
BA member of the Scarlet Brotherhood. He must have taken it to their library in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades!
BIf you want that book, then you'll have to go to the monastery to find it. And sorry about all the trouble. I'm not myself these days...
completion: That's it! It's just what I need to prepare for the ritual to create your wand! I hope it wasn't too much trouble to find...

1999.name: Tools of the Trade
desc: Find the Dalaran Status Report and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
objectives: Find the Dalaran Status Report and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
details: The wizards of the Kirin Tor at Ambermill have stored away important documents pertaining to the current state of Dalaran. This we know from the admissions of one of our prisoners. Lord Varimathras has placed the duty of recovering them in the hands of the Deathstalkers.
BThis task falls to you, $n. You will need some equipment, however, and the knowledge of lockpicking. Speak with Estelle Gendry, our outfitter, and ask her for a set of tools before you set out.
completion: Very good, $N! You have learned the fine art of lockpicking well, and faster than I could have possibly expected.
BI see that I was right to place my trust in you. Believe me, boy, I foresee that you will go far in this line of work.

2239.name: Onin's Report
desc: Take Onin's Report back to Hulfdan in Ironforge.
objectives: Take Onin's Report back to Hulfdan in Ironforge.
details: The Quarry? Yap, I see those monstrous armored steam tanks come by this post near every day.

BMy contacts to the east tell me that the tank starts off at Ironforge, makes a pickup at the Gol'Bolar Quarry, stops over at Kharanos to refuel and then for some blasted reason, it takes the long way around past Gnomeregan, before reaching Ironforge to drop off the shipment.
BIt's all in the report, $r. Take it back to Hulfdan so he can plan the next step.$B
completion: Long route? In the name o' me own beard!
BYe done good, $N. Take this dagger and be gone with ye. The Circle will call upon ye again when step three be ready to be set into motion.
BWhat's step three? It comes right after step two - me putting me boot up yer backside.
BInterested?

2359.name: Klaven's Tower
desc: Steal the Defias Tower Key, break into the Defias Tower and uncover the contents of the Duskwood Chest. Take whatever information you find back to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. Read Kearnen's Journal to gain insight about the tower.
objectives: Steal the Defias Tower Key, break into the Defias Tower and uncover the contents of the Duskwood Chest. Take whatever information you find back to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. Read Kearnen's Journal to gain insight about the tower.$B
details: I've been staking out this tower for weeks, $N. Recently a major shipment came through from Duskwood, and along with it came those guards.
BWhat are they? Your guess is as good as mine. I can tell you one thing - they aren't human.
BAnyhow, the shipment had a chest - which is what I assume those abominations are guarding. The zombie with the spikes holds a key we'll need.
BGet that key, get in the tower, and uncover whatever is in that chest. Take your findings back to Mathias.
completion: This would explain the Defias drones you and Kearnen saw outside of the tower, $N. It would also explain the Venture Company's involvement with the Defias and the strange shipments out of Duskwood.
BAccording to this book, the Zanzil trolls in Stranglethorn have discovered a way to raise the dead through potions... or to be more specific: poison.
BYou'll be of no use to SI:7 without a firm understanding of poisons, $N -- especially with the recipe to create undeath at our fingertips.

2383.name: Simple Parchment
desc: Read the Simple Parchment and speak to Frang in the Valley of Trials.
objectives: Read the Simple Parchment and speak to Frang in the Valley of Trials.
details: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.
BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the warrior trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.
completion: Ah, that's my parchment. I heard you'd be coming to the Valley, $n. I'm glad to see you made it--let's hope you survive the trials ahead. Like I said, as you gain in power, come to me--I will do what I can to train you in the ways of the warrior.
BGood luck, $n, and return to me whenever you feel ready.

2479.name: Hinott's Assistance
desc: Travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills and deliver the Sample of Zanzil's Mixture to Serge Hinott.
To get to Tarren Mill, take the Zeppelin to the Undercity and follow the road south through Silverpine and towards Hillsbrad. Follow the signs!
objectives: Travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills and deliver the Sample of Zanzil's Mixture to Serge Hinott.
BTo get to Tarren Mill, take the Zeppelin to the Undercity and follow the road south through Silverpine and towards Hillsbrad. Follow the signs!
B
details: Take a sample of the mixture to Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill.
BIf anyone can cure you, it's Serge. Live long enough and Serge will show you the ways of poison creation and use.
completion: You look deliciously pale, $C. And what is that foul aroma you are giving off? I must know!

2623.name: The Swamp Talker
desc: Retrieve the Warchief's Orders and return them to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
objectives: Retrieve the Warchief's Orders and return them to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
details: Orders were given by the dispatch commander. We took... took orders. On way to Blasted Lands, ambushed.
BMurlocs... Many murlocs... One named Swamp Talker. Took orders from my hands as spear thrust into my skull. East... cave....
B<Bengor passes out.>$B
completion: It is worse than I imagined. Nineteen of my men could have been spared from the agony which they faced. If only I had not acted so irrationally.
BYou must help them, $N! I am powerless to act.

2743.name: The Cover of Darkness
desc: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde with your findings.
objectives: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde with your findings.
details: Let us not mince words, $r; my time here is limited.
BYou must destroy the triad of power which protects the demon lord, Razelikh. Doing so will not be as simple a task as freeing a damned soul.
B<Kirith grins.>
BYou see, each of Razelikh's underlings wears a third of an amulet of Razelikh's creation around their neck. The very same amulet you will need in order to summon the arch demon.
BReturn to Trebor and tell him what is required to summon Razelikh. He will be able to instruct you further.
completion: The demon lord displays a cunning almost as calculated as his brutality, $N.

2767.name: Rescue OOX-22/FE!
desc: Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
objectives: Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
details: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:

B"I need to move OOX-22/FE to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure. It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again. Escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, the dock along the Forgotten Coast! That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things online!"
B"Escort it safely to the dock, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay! Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"
completion: Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-22/FE! I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! My homing robot series needs more development, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of extra rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in manufacture costs!
BPlease, take your choice of any of these items I have. Thank you again for your generous assistance $N, my robots and I are in your debt!

2863.name: Alpha Strike
desc: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.
objectives: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.
details: The plan is for various leaders of the gnolls - Alphas as they call themselves - to be taken down within rapid succession. If we're able to execute this sort of swift and precise devastation against them, it would cause chaos in their ranks. Perhaps it would also drive a message through their thick flea-bitten heads that we can and will destroy them!
BI want you to be the messenger of my will; eliminate five of their Alphas within one hour for this to work $N, or we'll remain at this impasse!
completion: You've done as I have asked, and for that I salute you. Take this small reward as compensation for your efforts, $N.
BWith their numbers thinned and their leaders slain, the gnolls will think twice about storming the camp. This doesn't conclude the issue at hand, however...
BThere must be some reason why the gnolls have been whipped into such a frenzied state. Before they have a chance to regroup though, I want to find out what is causing it.

2935.name: Consult Master Gadrin
desc: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
objectives: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
details: The venom from the broodguards wasn't as potent as the venom you brought originally. It must have come from a different spider.

BI want a fresh sample of that venom. To find out where it came from, you must consult with a troll who knows the Witherbark well--Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. Travel to Durotar and speak with Gadrin. With luck, he'll know where the Witherbarks get their venom.
completion: Ah, so you want fresh venom from the spider of the witherbarks, yes? Well, sit down... you're not going to like what I have to tell you.

2983.name: Call of Fire
desc: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
objectives: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
details: It's been some time since you were tested last, $N. You've been patient thus far in your studies, but it's time for you to learn about greater powers... it's time you learn real power. The element of fire is yours if you're prepared to pay for it.
BSeek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the blasted night elf lands, you've gone way too far.
completion: Hmmm, Swart sent you to me, did he?
BWell then, Swart could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

BI see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. Patience, $N. Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.

3103.name: Hallowed Letter
desc: Read the Hallowed Letter and speak to Priestess Anetta in Northshire Abbey.
objectives: Read the Hallowed Letter and speak to Priestess Anetta in Northshire Abbey.
details: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Priestess Anetta, our local priest trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
completion: As you grow in experience, return to me and I will do what I can to impart my knowledge upon you. Until then, go with compassion in your heart, and let wisdom be your guide. Remember, the world only becomes a better place if you make it so.

3127.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
desc: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
objectives: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
details: The last task I will require of you is to travel to the northwest and find the final enemy.

BThe mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the burning legion appeared in the world. You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.
BI am eager to harness power of that size. Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.
completion: Just imagine the possibilities of what we now possess, $N. Along with the materials that you have collected, I will be able to forever trap the muisek of these creatures into whatever I wish.

3367.name: Suntara Stones
desc: Help Dorius get back to Ironforge.
objectives: Help Dorius get back to Ironforge.$B
details: <Dorius groans.>
BI'm badly injured, $r. Feel... light headed... World spinning... Bleeding... internally.
BI must get back to Ironforge. Help me, $N.$B
completion: This letter was dropped by Dorius when he was shot.

3463.name: Set Them Ablaze!
desc: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.
objectives: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings. $B
details: Listen well, $N. While the four towers can never be destroyed, you can use the torch of retribution to set them ablaze for a very long period of time: A fire that no element or force can subdue.
BWhile they are ablaze, no guard or sentry unit can inhabit the watch posts and thus, their first line of defense is nullified.
BYou must enter each tower and use the Torch of Retribution within their fortifications. Beware the lookouts posted by the Dark Irons, $N.
completion: It is glorious! Is it not glorious master?

3511.name: The Name of the Beast
desc: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.
objectives: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.$B
details: As promised, I will reveal the name of the demon lord, Razelikh the Defiler. First, however, I must prepare something of utmost importance for your journey.
BThe weapon you seek to create requires a temper. Give me a moment to drain the blood from these heads.
B<Lord Arkkoroc squeezes the heads in between his gigantic fists, draining them of their blood.>
BTake the temper back to Loramus along with the name of the beast: Rakh'likh.
completion: The temper will add the necessary vitriol we require for the forging of the weapons. There is but one more step in their creation.
B

3631.name: Summon Felsteed
desc: Speak to Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.
objectives: Speak to Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.
details: Hmph. I say you're not prepared, but that is not my decision. Strahad feels otherwise, and it is his decision to make... this time.
BHe wishes to speak to you, and quickly. You'll find him still above Ratchet in the Barrens, at his little tower there with his acolytes.
BDo not dawdle long.
completion: Good luck, $N. I look forward to seeing you in the future.

3823.name: Extinguish the Firegut
desc: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.
objectives: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.
details: We must strike at our enemies before they strike at us!
BI'll make this brief, soldier.

BThe Firegut ogres of the Burning Steppes are allies of the Blackrock orcs. They work closely with those vile orcs, keeping the mineral rich Dreadmaul Rock guarded and the supply lines open at all times.
BLeave your mark, $N. Cripple their forces and return to me when the job is done.
B<Oralius grabs at the air and makes a choking motion.>
BI WILL KILL YOU, WINKY!
completion: Outstanding, soldier! The orcs and ogres will be reeling from this blow for minutes, maybe even hours!

4063.name: The Rise of the Machines
desc: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.
objectives: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.
details: This can't be Argelmach! Argelmach was killed ten years ago. How can I be sure? I was the one who killed him.
BHe was a despicable dwarf, hell-bent on twisting my life's work to meet his diabolical needs. It seems that the wicked always find a way to escape justice.

BIf this is Argelmach's handiwork then he must be destroyed. I will need samplings of his latest creations. With the proper samples, I may be able to stop this uprising. The creations guard Argelmach in Blackrock Depths.
completion: What is this?!? This head is not flesh. This is some sort of dark iron creation: A shadow of Argelmach - ANOTHER machine! I suspect that your destruction of Argelmach will be short lived as another shall rise to take 'its' place soon.

4135.name: The Writhing Deep
desc: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.
objectives: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.
details: Inside the backpacks are two items: the first is a parcel of goods that was bound for Thalanaar, and the second is a note hastily penned to an unknown reader.

BThe note tells of discovering insidious bug-like creatures south of the gnoll camps in a place called the Writhing Deep. The author felt the need to investigate it personally, as though it was a serious threat to all of Feralas. The note is signed, "Raschal of Feathermoon".
BIt would seem that you have located where Raschal ultimately went.
completion: You have discovered a large pod of an alien nature. The texture of the pod appears mucous, though hardened protrusions stick out from random parts of it. The pod itself has the height and width to easily encompass a humanoid inside of it... and from the faint humanoid shape visible through the skin of the pod, you surmise that this is what it indeed encapsulates.

4183.name: The True Masters
desc: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.
objectives: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.
details: We had always assumed that the Blackrock orcs were a product of their savage upbringing. What we have found here, in their homeland, tells us another story.

BIndeed, it is bloodlust and thirst for conflict that empowers them, but the black dragonflight are the beings whom control the orcs of Blackrock. We suspect that it is the black dragonflight that fuels them with rage and hostility.
BTake this letter to Magistrate Solomon. He will know what must be done.
B<Helendis hands you a sealed letter.>
completion: <Magistrate Solomon opens the sealed letter from Helendis and begins reading.>

4495.name: A Good Friend
desc: Find Iverron by the cave to the north.
objectives: Find Iverron by the cave to the north.
details: A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.
BI admit, I am a little worried, $N. Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!
BIf you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
completion: I'm so glad you found me, $N. How did you know I was here?

4735.name: Egg Collection
desc: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
details: $N, I'm finally ready for real samples of dragon eggs! Here, take this collectronic module. It's designed to extract a dragon egg and prepare it for transport. Go back to the Rookery and use the module to collect eggs.
BAnd don't forget to freeze them first, or they might hatch before you can collect them!
BWhen you have enough eggs, bring them to me!
completion: Wow, you got them! The collectronic module worked! I'm a genius!
BThank you, $N. My patron will be very pleased to get these eggs...

4783.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
desc: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: The next components are found in Desolace, far to the west of the Barrens and even the Stonetalon Mountains.
BThere, chaos still reigns after the Sundering. Both your strength and cunning will be tested there--you will face creatures of hatred and also of the Burning Legion.
BFrom the Hatefury satyr in the northeast, bring me their blood. From the lesser infernals in Mannoroc Coven, bring me a lesser infernal stone.
BWe will use both in the construction of your robe.
completion: Excellent, $N. These will do nicely. I will prepare them now while you move on to your last two components. Are you ready?

4903.name: Warlord's Command
desc: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
objectives: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
details: By order of Warlord Goretooth, the following inhabitants of Blackrock Spire must be destroyed:
BThe rotund menace, Highlord Omokk.
BThe cruel and ruthless troll, War Master Voone.
BOverlord Wyrmthalak, taskmaster of the lesser city.
BYou will also be required to return any important documents that you may find.
BSucceed and be honored.
BFail and be forgotten.
completion: <Warlord Goretooth's dull green skin turns a pasty white for a brief moment.>

4975.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
desc: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.
objectives: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.
details: I will get started immediately on crafting your orb and infusing your new demon into it. When done, you will have the choice of having it in the form of a staff or orb. I always felt it was important to cater to a warlock's chosen weapon... I see no reason not to continue that practice.
completion: It is done, $N. Simply tell me which you'd prefer: a staff that would require you to use both hands, or an orb so you may use a dagger or sword as your weapon.
BTackling the infernal was a great feat on your part and this reward will fit you nicely. I wish you further success in the arts, $N.

5023.name: Better Late Than Never
desc: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.
objectives: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.
details: You pick up the package, wiping off a small layer of dust and grime that had settled on it. It is addressed in a hurried hand to a Jeremiah Felstone of Lordaeron; the delivery of the package is dated for well over four years ago.

BThough it is unclear if Jeremiah Felstone is even alive, it is widely known that the Undercity, formerly known as Lordaeron, keeps records on the populace of the city. This is handled through the Royal Overseers of the Undercity Census.
completion: A package for a Jeremiah Felstone, with his last known address as Lordaeron... I should be able to assist you.

BJeremiah Felstone was in the city before the plague. Well, I should say the former Jeremiah Felstone - some of the Forsaken have changed their last names to rid themselves of their former countenance. This case is no exception; the former Jeremiah Felstone is now known as Jeremiah Payson.
BWait a minute... isn't he the cockroach vendor?

5047.name: Finkle Einhorn, At Your Service!
desc: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
objectives: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
details: You'll find Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook, $c. Tell him that 'Finkle is A-OK' and that the suit works perfectly.
BThen hand him this:
B<Finkle hands you a glowing piece of flesh.>
BI snatched it from the beast's innards during my 'vacation.'
BI bet Malyfous could give you a fairly accurate assessment of what he can do with parts from a monster like this!
BOh, I suppose you don't know where Everlook is, do you? To Winterspring, $g fella:lady;!
completion: Alive? Suit worked? And what do we have here?

5095.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
desc: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.
objectives: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.
details: Heroes of the realm, hear me - the Horde calls upon you for swift action!

BA call to arms has been issued for all able bodied individuals to take up arms against the Scourge! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Eastern Kingdoms. They loom to the east of the Undercity, in the northern reaches of the lands now known as the Plaguelands!
BHeroes of the realm - seek out High Executor Derrington, who has set up his base camp at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades!
completion: Welcome to the Plaguelands, hero. This is one of the most dangerous frontiers in Azeroth, with the looming threat of the Scourge to our east, and then even further still eastward from there. I am glad to hear that the call of duty and service to the Horde did not fall on deaf ears with you!
BIf you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the Plaguelands.

5143.name: Tribal Leatherworking
desc: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
objectives: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.
BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
details: To learn tribal leatherworking demands an understanding of how primal nature truly is; I know that you have already mastered the art of making wild leather armor, and I am willing to complete your training.

BKnow this, $c: by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or elemental leatherworking; there is only room for practice of one of the three arts. Furthermore, bring to me the finest samples of your wild leather armor. From there, we will begin your mastery.
completion: You've given your finest offerings, and nature will soon permit you to bend her to your will. Once I have finished my tutelage, your work will be a force of nature unto itself.
BTo train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.

5167.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
desc: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
5 Skin of Shadow.
objectives: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
B1 Chromatic Carapace.
B10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
B10 Blood of Heroes.
B5 Skin of Shadow.
details: The carapace of a mature chromatic drake is needed to form the foundation of the leggings. Brilliant chromatic scales are then layered upon the wire frame and enchanted in the blood of heroes. Finally, the supple skin of shadow must be applied to the inner greaves.
completion: They will smell their kin as you enter their halls, $N. Crush them with their own fear!

5215.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
desc: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
details: Within the lands of former Lordaeron are eight cauldrons - four here in the west, and four more ensconced in the east. These cauldrons spew poisons into the air, propagating the plague throughout the land for the Scourge.

BThe necromantic might of Kel'Thuzad is too strong to outright shut down these cauldrons, but we think we might have a way to subvert them to our advantage. My second, High Priestess MacDonnell, will be your point on this assignment; she'll continue the briefing from here.
completion: May the power of the Light shine upon you in these dark times, $c. I am pleased to serve as your coordinator for our plan to sabotage the Scourge's cauldrons.

BOur goal will be to change the composition of the plague that the cauldrons create into something that negatively affects the Scourge. In order to affect this change, you will need to secure access to each of the four cauldrons present in the Western Plaguelands.
BStand ready hero, for a glorious battle against the vile Scourge awaits you!

5263.name: Above and Beyond
desc: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
objectives: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.$B
details: You display a natural aptitude for destruction and you follow orders. It is rare to see the two coexist. I am beginning to think that you may make an excellent vehicle of divine justice.
B<Zverenhoff clasps his hands together in front of his face.>
BKel'Thuzad's errand boy rules over Stratholme. Prove to me that you are a champion - my champion. Destroy Baron Rivendare and return to me with his head. $B
completion: It has been many years since I have ushered a champion into our ranks. You are the first to be granted audience with Lord Maxwell in years.

5503.name: Argent Dawn Commission
completion: All who fight evil on behalf of the Argent Dawn must don our commission. Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer.

BWhile under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess. Procure these insignia and bring them to me. For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the Argent Dawn Valor Token.
BAchieve your destiny, $C join the fight today!

5527.name: A Reliquary of Purity
desc: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
objectives: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
details: The first step is to find a container capable of holding an extremely corruptible substance without the handler suffering ill effects. There is only one sort device I am aware of that could possibly contain something as vile as the Felvine: a Reliquary of Purity.

BDeep in the wasteland of Silithus is the remnants of the night elf village known as Southwind. I know one was there many, many years ago. If we are to succeed, I need you to scour those ruins in the hopes of reclaiming it.
completion: Indeed, you are as resourceful as many claim. The Cenarion Circle is blessed to have you working in our stead.
BWith the Reliquary once more in our hands, my mind is at ease. I feel more comfortable asking you to not only face down a malfeasant demon, but also to bring back a dangerous item in the process...

5623.name: In Favor of the Light
desc: Speak to Priestess Josetta in Elwynn Forest.
objectives: Speak to Priestess Josetta in Elwynn Forest.
details: Hello again, young $gpriest:priestess;. The time has come for you to learn more about our religion. After you've completed whatever tasks you have here in Northshire, please seek out Priestess Josetta in Goldshire. She has more to teach you and has heard that you are growing strong in the ways of the Light. She looks forward to tutoring you more.
completion: I'm glad you've arrived, $N. We have much to discuss about your future and your path within the Light.

5647.name: A Lack of Fear
desc: Speak to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge.
details: Your race is so very strong, $N. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to not only finding your true origins, but find great confidence that you are on the right path in so many things. That feeling must make you feel so triumphant.
BWord came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priest Rohan in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep him waiting. May Elune guide your travels.
completion: You've got the makings of a great $C, $N. Keep up the good work!
BYou've already shown you're ready for battle. Perhaps it's time we taught ya a little somethin' more.

5863.name: The Dunemaul Compound
desc: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
objectives: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
details: Just recently, a large band of nomadic ogres arrived in Tanaris. South of here, they have taken over a large area of the desert and formed a compound. Several smaller bands are currently wandering the desert, some of which have invaded the old troll ruins.
BThe Dunemaul Compound must be destroyed! We cannot allow these ogres to build up a force.
BThe leader of this band is named Gor'marok the Ravager; I believe that putting an end to his leadership will be the beginning of the end for the ogres.
completion: I'm so glad you were able to do this for me, $N! Thanks for your help!

5887.name: Salve via Hunting
completion: Very well then, here are your Cenarion plant salves. Scour Felwood for corrupted plants, $n! Wherever they are, use the salve I have given you to purify them.

6031.name: Runecloth
desc: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
objectives: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
details: In Timbermaw, we are content. We do not like strangers. This is good for us, but it is bad for trade.
