BNot long ago, a rare night elf friend came to Timbermaw and she wore a runecloth cloak. Runecloth is rare among us, but the cloak was so fine my people want me to make more runecloth clothing.
BWill you bring me runecloth? If you bring me enough, then I will give you something in trade.
completion: Ah, you brought the cloth. Such fine material it is!
BThank you, $N. You are a true friend. Please accept this in exchange.

6103.name: Training the Beast
desc: Speak to Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus.
objectives: Speak to Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus.
details: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
BTravel to Darnassus. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Jocaste. She will give you the ability to train your new pet, so make haste.
BWhile Jocaste may seem stern, she is always pleased to see another hunter rising through the ranks. Treat her with respect and she will return in kind. Good luck, $N.
completion: A fledgling $C. I see. Yes. I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
BRemember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

6127.name: The Principal Source
desc: Use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler to draw a sample of water from a pool at the top of the peak.
Deliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, Barrens.
objectives: Use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler to draw a sample of water from a pool at the top of the peak.
BDeliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, Barrens.
details: Dreadmist Peak to the northwest of the Crossroads is most likely a primary candidate as to the source of the spread of the poison. Its airy peaks have pools of water that influence the weather patterns. I suspect the water is now tainted by the demon-worshipping Burning Blade.

BUse this sampler to draw water from the pool at the very top of the peak. Once filled, deliver it to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads. He is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with him to address this malady.
completion: By my ancestors, this water is disgusting! No wonder the gazelles are sick.

BSomething is polluting the water, and in turn beginning to wreck the northern Barrens ecosystem. Sick gazelles have been sighted all north of the east-west road here. While this water is most likely a primary source of the sickness spreading, there's something else at work here.
BThis water, believe it or not, will help us formulate a cure. While I research this water, I have need of some items to formulate a cure...

6343.name: Return to Nessa
desc: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.
objectives: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.
details: I must send a response to Nessa. She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along Teldrassil's coastline. We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!

BPlease, take this response to Nessa. If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather. If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.
completion: This is very interesting. The fish here are large, but I didn't think the difference in bounties between here and the mainland was so great. There must be a reason for this...
BWell thank you, $N. I will discuss with the villagers the news you brought. Perhaps, one day, we will find the root of this oddity. But until then, we shall reap its benefits!

6391.name: Ride to Ironforge
desc: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.
objectives: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.
details: For just a few coins, one of my gryphons will take you to Ironforge. From there, deliver Brock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe. You'll find him in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild. That's in the Great Forge District of Ironforge, which is right where my gryphon will drop you off!
BSpeak to me again when you're ready for the journey.
completion: Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils. I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go. I just need to chisel in the names of the students...

6583.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
desc: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.
objectives: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.
details: Just as our Father crushes the Aspects themselves, so too must we strive to bring chaos and destruction to their children.
BYou must test your battle prowess against the sleepless dreamers: The children of the Green Flight.
BTravel to the Swamp of Sorrows and track down Somnus, drake champion of the Green Flight. Let flow your hatred; dominate the insect... Return to me with his skull...
completion: Another complete...

6607.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
desc: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!
objectives: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
BMisty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
BA Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
BFeralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
BSavage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
BReturn to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!
details: Can't say I really enjoy fishin' much. Figure I been at it for a good 20 or 30 years now.
BI reckon people are driven to do what they do for different reasons.

BNow, I'm not saying you need to fish for 30 years or catch every fish in the sea to become a master fisherman. I reckon you just need to be determined - determined enough to sit on your duff for hours at a time, doin' nothin'.
BI'll tell you what, catch me a few rare fish and I'll teach you a thing or two. Here's a list:
completion: Now that's a fine catch!
BCome over here, lemme show you how to set a few lines.

6823.name: Agent of Hydraxis
desc: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
objectives: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
details: If you truly wish an allegiance with us, then I invite you to wage war on our foes, the servants of air and earth and fire. Each defeat you heap upon them will weaken their foothold here, and further prove your adherence to our cause.
BThe campaign will be long, but if you persevere then your glory and honor will be great.
completion: Your exploits against our enemies ring through the chambers of the Waterlords, $N. It was thought by some that your form is too small and fragile to fight in our war, but you have made great gains. You have earned respect among us, an unbelievable feat.

6847.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
desc: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

7063.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
desc: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
objectives: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
details: Here - if you are interested in learning more about the Feast of Winter Veil, read this book. While I think our recognition of the legend is the appropriate one, I'm enough of a scholar to appreciate the collection of all information into a single source.
BWhen you're done, take the book to King Magni Bronzebeard. I know for a fact he'd be interested in hearing that others have taken an interest in the older legends.
completion: The legends and lore surrounding the Winter Veil are ones that have faded from the forefront of public thought over the years. While I recognize that the goblins are helping to revive the season for their own ends, the fact that the citizenry thinks about it at least in some form does good to keep such lore alive.
BYour desire to go beyond the material and learn about our past is an admirable trait, young $C. I salute your erudite nature.

7423.name: I've Got A Fever For More Bone Chips

7495.name: Victory for the Alliance
desc: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.
objectives: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.
details: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to the Highlord.
completion: For so many years I was held under her captivating gaze. Finally, to see justice meted and the honor of Stormwind restored! Today, we celebrate this glorious victory!

7639.name: To Show Due Judgment
desc: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
objectives: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
details: With my blessings, take the censer. I myself have used it in several exorcisms, and it should serve you well for the arduous tasks that lie ahead.
BReturn now to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind, $N. Your quest continues with him.
completion: Yes, this will do. You will be called upon more than once during this process to make acts of sacrifice; I am glad to see that you are willing to do just that. Sacrifice is a key component in what it takes to uphold the duties of being a Paladin... but I don't have to lecture you on that.
BNow $N, you will need to show due judgment in your actions. To that end, this censer will act as your vessel to dispense such judgment on tortured spirits of lands lost to us.

7735.name: Pristine Yeti Hide
desc: Bring the Pristine Yeti Hide to Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

7783.name: The Lord of Blackrock
desc: Return the Head of Nefarian to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Return the Head of Nefarian to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
details: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. Return it to your Warchief, champion.
completion: You have honored the Horde once more, $N. The son of Deathwing lays dead. Surely, the evil one stirs.

7807.name: A Donation of Wool
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7831.name: A Donation of Mageweave
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7927.name: Darkmoon Portals Deck
desc: Return the Portals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

8047.name: The Heathen's Brand
completion: Our beliefs differ but our cause is righteous. Strike down our foes, noble $c.

8071.name: Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Mantle
desc: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Aegis. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Aegis. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: The confessors of the Zandalar all wear a distinctive mantle, marking them as the preservers of the tribe. These mantles are woven with powerful mojo that aids them in judging those who would threaten our tribe. As a priest, you too must spend your time judging those worthy and not; such a mantle would definitely be a blessing to you.
BIn exchange for fighting Hakkar's minions in Zul'Gurub and bringing me the Paragons of Power I seek, I will give you a mantle worthy of our finest confessors.
completion: Well done, $N - the minions of Hakkar have surely felt the retribution of the Zandalar today, thanks to you. Your actions have given you a permanent place of reverence within the tribe. With our blessing, please take this confessor's mantle as your own!

8119.name: The Unmarred Vision of Voodress
completion: One day, $n, you will be able to use this orb to communicate directly with me. Whenever this battle with Hakkar be over and Maywiki go home. Let us call to the spirits and ask them for that day to come soon.

8143.name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
completion: An assassin of your caliber should be given a wide berth. Your foes must learn respect! You will get just that when the enemy sees the glint of Death's Hand - all too late...

8167.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
desc: Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
details: $N, the battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources and territory. Key points in the area must be held and operated in order to supply our forces with much needed raw materials and supplies. I charge you to assault the points farthest from our Arathi Basin base.
BAssault the farm, the mine, the lumber mill and the blacksmith when they are controlled by the enemy. Find the enemy's banner and rip it from its flag post!
BWhen you have done this to all four points, return to me.
completion: NULL

8191.name: Prophetic Aura
desc: Bring me thise things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
Primal Hakkari Idol
Punctured Voodoo Doll

8263.name: Defiler's Basic Care Package
completion: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, $N. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Arathi Basin.

BAs you continue to prove yourself inside the Basin, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. Rations become available when you are Honored with us, and bandages when you are Revered.

8287.name: A Terrible Purpose
desc: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
objectives: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
details: Ok, here we are... a pretty valuable chunk of information, I must say! I've seen the Cenarion Circle forces arrive at Silithus. They plan to drive the Twilight's Hammer out, don't they? This will help.
BTake this parchment to their leader, Commander Mar'alith. Soon the Twilight's Hammer will be vanquished and I will be outside their grasp for good!
completion: This is very interesting information indeed, $N. This sheds some light on the presence of the Twilight's Hammer in Silithus and will undoubtedly help us in our struggle against them. Your efforts will be handsomely rewarded, $C.

8311.name: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!
desc: Speak with the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, as well as Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.
Return to Jesper at the Stormwind Orphanage with a Darnassus Marzipan, Gnomeregan Gumdrop, Stormwind Nougat, and Ironforge Mint.
objectives: Speak with the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, as well as Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.
BReturn to Jesper at the Stormwind Orphanage with a Darnassus Marzipan, Gnomeregan Gumdrop, Stormwind Nougat, and Ironforge Mint.
details: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

BEach of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! Also, a little gnome named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well. When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
completion: Wow, you got them all! You're awesome!
BThank you for trick-or-treating for me. Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!
BHappy Hallow's End, $N!

8359.name: Flexing for Nougat
desc: Do a flex emote at Innkeeper Gryshka, and in exchange you'll receive Orgrimmar Nougat!

8383.name: Remember Alterac Valley!
desc: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8407.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8431.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8503.name: The Alliance Needs Stranglekelp!
desc: Bring 20 Stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 20 Stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: So, $c, did I already tell you about all of the fabulous uses stranglekelp has? I did? Oh well... in any case we need a lot of it, and when I say a lot, I mean A LOT! Do you think that you could help us out? I know that it means going without all of those wonderful things that you can make with it, but it's for a good cause!
completion: Hooray! That's another twenty down. You're the best. I suppose that I should get these all packed away before they wither. So much stranglekelp, so little time!
BThanks again, $C!

8527.name: The Alliance Needs More Roast Raptor!
desc: Bring 20 roast raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8551.name: The Captain's Chest
desc: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
objectives: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
details: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor. I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.
BUntil...

BThose cursed sea giants ruined me! They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay. And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest. He said he wanted it for a snuffbox. The nerve!
BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here. Find him and get back my chest! Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
completion: You found it! Oh happy day, this is! Thank you, $N. Getting back my chest cools some of the fire in me.
BBut my revenge isn't complete...

8575.name: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
desc: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
objectives: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
details: You cannot understand a single word on this ledger. You don't even know what language it is written in!
completion: <Narain eagerly examines the letter.>
BOutstanding, $R! What is it? I can't read a lick of Draconic.

8599.name: Love Song for Narain
desc: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
objectives: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
details: It isn't often that I get visitors. As a matter of fact, the last time I had a visitor was when I rescued that dear, sweet gnome from the wreckage of the crashed flying machine.
B<Meridith gazes into nothingness, lost in a memory.>
BDo you know him? Narain? Narain Soothfancy? Oh it would mean so much to me if somebody would deliver a message to him for me. I must tell him how I feel! I know it's love! I just know it!
BCould you possibly deliver a message to Narain? I would be forever indebted to you!
completion: What!?
B<Narain starts to fidget.>
BWell, um... What do you want me to do??? She's a fish! A FISH I tell you! And I'm a gnome. It could never work out.

8623.name: Stormcaller's Diadem
desc: Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8647.name: Bellowrage the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8671.name: Ragetotem the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8695.name: Cape of Eternal Justice
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Obsidian Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Obsidian Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.
BI shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.
BI promise you won't be disappointed.
completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.
BTake this cloak, $N. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.

8719.name: Bladesing the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8743.name: Bang a Gong!

objectives.target: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands

completion: From the ground near the gong springs a special crystal. Perhaps favor from the Brood.

8767.name: A Gently Shaken Gift
completion: This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads:$b$bTo a very special $r $c.

8791.name: The Fall of Ossirian
desc: Deliver the Head of Ossirian the Unscarred to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
objectives: Deliver the Head of Ossirian the Unscarred to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.$B
details: A terrible menace has been laid to rest. The cruel Ossirian has been vanquished.
BThe denizens of Kalimdor would be relieved to know of this victory. Take Ossirian's head and present it to Commander Mar'alith of Cenarion Hold.
completion: I offer you my highest commendation and your choice of an item of power, $N. You have done the people of Kalimdor a great service.

8911.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dreadmist Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dreadmist Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.$B
details: Well met, $c. I've something that might interest you.

BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
completion: Excellent! Let's perform the trade then. It's hard to part with this excellent armor, but I'm afraid I won't be needing it any time soon.
BIf you're interested in performing more work for me, I might be willing to give up the rest of the pieces.

8935.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
completion: You've kept your end of the bargain, I shall keep mine.
BJust remember that I'm holding on to the best pieces until your work is finished.

8959.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Boots of Valor, Legplates of Valor and Spaulders of Valor.
objectives: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Boots of Valor, Legplates of Valor and Spaulders of Valor.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
BWell, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.

8983.name: Tracing the Source
desc: Speak with Mara Rennick at the tailor's shop in the Undercity's Mage Quarter.
objectives: Speak with Mara Rennick at the tailor's shop in the Undercity's Mage Quarter.
details: Something's wrong with my product? Well, I've never seen so many people wanting something so badly.
BI bought my supply from a merchant named Mara Rennick. She's new in town.
BShe mentioned she had some goods she had to deliver to the tailor in the Mage Quarter.
completion: I'm afraid I sold my entire supply of perfume and cologne to Norman, the innkeeper. If you'd like some, you should speak with him - assuming he has any left.
BYou shouldn't waste any time, though. I think you'll find the cologne irresistible.

9007.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Mokvar your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
objectives: Give Mokvar your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
details: A truly amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
completion: I will truly miss you, $N. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.
BEnjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!

9055.name: Cryptstalker Legguards
desc: Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Legguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 3 Arcanite Bars and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.

9079.name: Bonescythe Helmet
desc: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Bonescythe Helmet if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Helmet, 15 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 8 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 75 gold pieces.

9103.name: Plagueheart Robe
desc: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Plagueheart Robe if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Robe, 25 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9223.name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn
desc: For 20 Insignias of the Dawn and 20 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

9247.name: The Keeper's Call
desc: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: BIn times past you have served the interests of the Argent Dawn, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.
B$N, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands if you are willing to aid us once more.
completion: Simply by answering the call, we are in your debt, $n. The Argent Dawn is certain that through your shining example, others that are here to aid us will gain great insight into how best to throw back this Scourge Invasion!

items.name: A Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls

9271.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
desc: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
details: This final task will be the most difficult of all, $N. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.

BTake the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.
completion: NULL

9295.name: Letter from the Front
desc: Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
completion: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.
BThere is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in Stormwind owes me a favor...
BThank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.

9319.name: A Light in Dark Places
desc: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
objectives: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
details: We are not the only ones who celebrate this holiday, $n. All creatures, all cultures, are touched by the flame. Even in the darkest places, the fires are being lit.

BIf you wish to see them for yourself, travel into the depths. Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, among the ogres of Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I will await your return.
completion: You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.

9367.name: The Festival of Fire
desc: Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
objectives: Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
details: Midsummer is upon us once again!

BEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.
BIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
completion: Excellent! It seems we've appointed dutiful Flamekeepers this year if the bonfires are as well-kept as you claim. Thank you for inspecting them for me; here, take this as a small token of my esteem.

9415.name: Report to Marshal Bluewall
desc: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
objectives: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
details: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.
BWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?
BNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
completion: The Alliance needs every able body they can get. The Horde has been receiving a steady supply of reinforcements from the northern part of the continent, and it's been a struggle to keep up.
BLet me explain the situation to you.

objectives: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
* Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman
details: My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!
If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

objectives: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in .
* Dark Iron Map (provided)
details: <The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>

objectives: Sit near 's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
*Sit near the campfire
*Gain the Boosted Rest buff
details: ;Elwynn Forest
Well howdy there, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
;Durotar
Lok-tar, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
;Tirisfal Glades
Greetings, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

objectives: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
details: Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.

objectives: Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
*Abandoned Training Weapon (6)
details: With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.

objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.
*Menethil Statuette (provided)
details: King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.
The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathdral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.

objectives: Return 4 Thicket Raptor Hides to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.
* Thicket Raptor Hide (4)
details: The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?
I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
